# Import and tidy up data
## experiment 1 (post exclusion, n = 120)
imported for later use in the Quantifying naive theories of ownership section of the manuscript
```{r import and format exp. 1 data}
study1_data <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/10.exp1-cleaned-data.csv")%>%select(unique_id,data_type,batch,trial_condition,manipulation_type,A_intentionality, B_intentionality, B_knowledge,blue_agent_first, object_cost,A,B, which_Voronoi_group)%>%mutate(which_study = "study 1")

study1_voronoidata <- study1_data %>%
  mutate(B_intentionality=case_when(B_intentionality=="intend to own" ~ "intend to own",
                                    B_intentionality=="no intent to own" ~ "no intent to own",
                                    TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         B_knowledge=case_when(B_knowledge=="knowledgeable" ~ "knowledgeable",
                                    B_knowledge=="ignorant" ~ "ignorant",
                                    TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         B_intentionality = factor(B_intentionality, levels=c("Not Applicable", "no intent to own", "intend to own")),
         B_knowledge = factor(B_knowledge, levels=c("Not Applicable", "ignorant", "knowledgeable")))
```

## experiment 2
```{r import raw data}
# prolific batch 1
batch1 <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/00.exp2-raw-batch1.csv")%>%mutate(batch=1)
batch1_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/01.exp2-attnchecks-batch1.csv")%>%mutate(batch=1)

# prolific batch 2
batch2 <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/02.exp2-raw-batch2.csv")%>%mutate(batch=2)
batch2_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/03.exp2-attnchecks-batch2.csv")%>%mutate(batch=2)

# prolific batch 3
batch3 <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/04.exp2-raw-batch3.csv")%>%mutate(batch=3)
batch3_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/05.exp2-attnchecks-batch3.csv")%>%mutate(batch=3)

# bind all
data <- rbind(batch1, batch2, batch3)
attn_checks <- rbind(batch1_attnchecks, batch2_attnchecks, batch3_attnchecks)
```

```{r apply inclusion criteria}
# filter based on color question
L_filtered_id <- attn_checks %>%
  filter(attn_check_1_response=="yellow") %>%
  distinct(unique_id)

# set up trial names, create and select relevant columns
L_data <- data%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% L_filtered_id$unique_id)%>%
  mutate(data_type="within subjects",
         manipulation_type = case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "1 agent,")==TRUE ~ "baseline",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "attention_checks")==TRUE ~ "attention_checks",
                                 TRUE ~ "main"),
         A_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "intentional")==TRUE ~ "intentional drop",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "no drop")==TRUE ~ "no drop-off",
                                       TRUE ~ "accidental drop"),
         B_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "pickup")==TRUE ~ "intend to own",
                                         str_detect(trial_condition, "walkaway")==TRUE ~ "no intent to own",
                                       TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         B_knowledge=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "aware")==TRUE ~ "knowledgeable",
                                    str_detect(trial_condition, "ignorant")==TRUE ~ "ignorant",
                                    TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         blue_agent_first=case_when(str_detect(agent_order, "A_2,A_1")==TRUE ~ FALSE,
                                       TRUE ~ TRUE))%>%
  select(unique_id,data_type,batch,trial_condition,manipulation_type,A_intentionality,B_intentionality,B_knowledge,
         blue_agent_first, A1_value, A2_value, agreement_rating, object_cost_response,id)

# extract object cost judgments
L_data_object_cost <-L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="attention_checks")%>%
  select(unique_id, object_cost_response)

# add object cost judgments to ownership judgment data
L_data_long <- L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type!="attention_checks")%>%
  rename(A=A1_value, B = A2_value)%>%
  gather(agent, value, A,B)%>%
  select(-object_cost_response)%>%
  left_join(L_data_object_cost)%>%
  rename(object_cost = object_cost_response)

L_data_long$object_cost <- as.numeric(L_data_long$object_cost)
L_data_long$value <- as.numeric(L_data_long$value)
L_data_long$agent <- factor(L_data_long$agent, levels=c("A", "B"))

# filter out participants based on pre-registered exclusion criteria
baseline_data<- L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & agent=="B")%>% 
  spread(agent,value)%>%
  spread(trial_condition,B)

baseline_wide <- baseline_data%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise_all(function(x){x[!is.na(x)]})%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")

strict_baseline_filter_id <- baseline_wide%>%
  filter(`1 agent,accidental`==0 & `1 agent,intentional`==0 & `1 agent,no drop`==0)

strict_baseline_filtered_data_long <- L_data_long%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)

# report inclusion rate
nrow(strict_baseline_filter_id)/nrow(L_filtered_id) # 79.5%
nrow(L_filtered_id) - nrow(strict_baseline_filter_id) # 31 participants excluded
```

# Replication of Exp. 1
## Summary statistics and tests for baseline and main trials
```{r prepare dataframe}
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_intentionality <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_intentionality,levels = c("Not Applicable", "no intent to own", "intend to own"))
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$A_intentionality <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$A_intentionality,levels = c("no drop-off","accidental drop","intentional drop"))
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_knowledge <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_knowledge,levels = c("Not Applicable", "knowledgeable","ignorant"))

Main_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  spread(agent,value)

Baseline_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
  spread(agent,value)
```

### Baseline trials
```{r summary statistics}
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
  group_by(A_intentionality,agent)%>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value),
            SD = sd(value))%>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r paired t-test for the original owner}
A_nodrop <- Baseline_conditions%>%filter(A_intentionality=="no drop-off")%>%select(A)
A_accidental <- Baseline_conditions%>%filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%select(A)
A_intentional <- Baseline_conditions%>%filter(A_intentionality=="intentional drop")%>%select(A)

t.test(A_nodrop$A, A_accidental$A, paired = TRUE)
t_to_d(9.2747, df=119, paired = T)

t.test(A_accidental$A, A_intentional$A, paired = TRUE)
t_to_d(10.907, df=119, paired = T)
```

### Main trials
#### Trials where the original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership
```{r percentage and Fisher's exact test}
# percentage of judging one agent owns more than the other
Main_conditions%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop" & B_intentionality=="intend to own")%>%
  mutate(Difference_AB = A-B,
         What_difference = case_when(Difference_AB>0 ~ "A owns more",
                                 Difference_AB==0 ~ "equal",
                                 TRUE ~ "B owns more"))%>%
  group_by(trial_condition, What_difference)%>%
    summarise(count=n(),
              freq=count/120)

# Fisher's exact test
## Exp 1
accidental_pickup <-data.frame(knowledgeable=c(71,49),# (1) B didn't own more, (2) B owns more
                               ignorant=c(55,65)) # (3) B didn't own more, (4) B owns more
fisher.test(accidental_pickup)
### result: p = .052

## Exp 2
accidental_pickup <-data.frame(knowledgeable=c(61,59), # (1) B didn't own more, (2) B owns more
                               ignorant=c(47,73)) # (3) B didn't own more, (4) B owns more
59/120 # % B owns more in knowledgeable trial
73/120 # % B owns more in ignorant trial
fisher.test(accidental_pickup)
### result: p = .09

## Exp 1 & 2
accidental_pickup <-data.frame(knowledgeable=c(132,108), # (1) B didn't own more, (2) B owns more
                               ignorant=c(102,138)) # (3) B didn't own more, (4) B owns more
108/240 # % B owns more in knowledgeable trial
138/240 # % B owns more in ignorant trial

fisher.test(accidental_pickup)
### results: p = .008
```

## Voronoi partition
### set up the Voronoi space
```{r build functions}
get_Voronoi_freq_CIs <- function(which_df){
  voronoi_freq_CIs <- which_df%>%
    mutate(G1 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==1 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G2 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==2 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G3 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==3 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G4 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==4 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G5 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==5 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE)
           )
  
  G1_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G1, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G1\nneither A or B owns")
  
  G2_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G2, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G2\nA owns, B doesn't")
  
  G3_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G3, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G3\nunsure")
  
  G4_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G4, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G4\nA doesn't, B owns")
  
  G5_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G5, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G5\nBoth A and B own")
  
  voronoi_freq_CIs <- rbind(G1_CIs, G2_CIs, G3_CIs, G4_CIs, G5_CIs)
  return(voronoi_freq_CIs)
}
```

```{r read in assigned Voronoi group for participants}
# write data for voronoi partition

# write_csv(Baseline_conditions, "./data/exp-2/08.exp2-baseline-conditions.csv")

# read in voronoi data
data_voronoi <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/09.exp2-main-conditions-voronoi.csv")
data_voronoi_baseline <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/10.exp2-baseline-conditions-voronoi.csv")
all_voronoi <- rbind(data_voronoi, data_voronoi_baseline)
```

```{r summary statistics of participants in each voronoi area}
Main_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs <- get_Voronoi_freq_CIs(data_voronoi)
Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs <- get_Voronoi_freq_CIs(data_voronoi_baseline)
```

### binomial testing of intuition significance
```{r baseline trials with (SI) Table. 9}
# baseline trials
strict_baseline_voronoi_freq<- Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
  select(trial_condition, which_Voronoi_group_text, mean, n)%>%
  ungroup()

baseline_binom_df <- strict_baseline_voronoi_freq%>% # provides information in SI Table. 9
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(nSuccess = n*mean,
         pSuccess = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$estimate,3),
         pValue = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,3))%>%
  mutate(is_a_theory = case_when(pSuccess>0.2 & pValue < .05 ~ TRUE,
                                 TRUE ~ FALSE),
         trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels=c("1 agent,intentional","1 agent,accidental","1 agent,no drop")))%>%
  select(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group_text,is_a_theory,pSuccess,pValue,nSuccess,n)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)

baseline_trial_condition_no <- baseline_binom_df%>%
  group_by(trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(n())%>%
  mutate(trial_no=1:n())%>%
  select(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  ungroup()

baseline_binom_df_isTheory <- baseline_trial_condition_no%>%
  left_join(baseline_binom_df)%>%
  filter(is_a_theory==TRUE)%>%
  select(-is_a_theory)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)
  
df_baseline_no_theories <- baseline_binom_df_isTheory%>%
  group_by(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(no_significant_theories=n())%>%
  select(trial_no, trial_condition, no_significant_theories)

```

```{r main trials with (SI) Table. 10}
strict_data_voronoi_freq<- Main_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
  select(trial_condition, which_Voronoi_group_text, mean, n)%>%
  ungroup()

binom_df <- strict_data_voronoi_freq%>% # provides information in SI Table. 10
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(nSuccess = n*mean,
         pSuccess = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$estimate,3),
         pValue = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,3))%>%
  mutate(is_a_theory = case_when(pSuccess>0.2 & pValue < .05 ~ TRUE,
                                 TRUE ~ FALSE),
         trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels = c("2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup",
                                                                        "2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway",
                                                                        "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup",
                                                                        "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway",
                                                                        "2 agents,intentional,aware,pickup",
                                                                        "2 agents,intentional,aware,walkaway",
                                                                        "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,pickup",
                                                                        "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,walkaway")))%>%
  select(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group_text,is_a_theory,pSuccess,pValue,nSuccess,n)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)

trial_condition_no <- binom_df%>%
  group_by(trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(n())%>%
  mutate(trial_no=1:n())%>%
  select(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  ungroup()

binom_df_isTheory <- trial_condition_no%>%
  left_join(binom_df)%>%
  filter(is_a_theory==TRUE)%>%
  select(-is_a_theory)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)
  
df_no_theories <- binom_df_isTheory%>%
  group_by(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(no_significant_theories=n())%>%
  select(trial_no, trial_condition, no_significant_theories)
```

## Logistic regression on object costs for two-intuition trials
```{r baseline trials}
# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership
baseline_trial2_group1and2 <- data_voronoi_baseline%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="1 agent,accidental")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==1 | which_Voronoi_group==2)%>%
  mutate(`Trial2 G1 & G2` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(1,2)))
lm_baseline_trial2_group1and2 <- glm(`Trial2 G1 & G2` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=baseline_trial2_group1and2)
summary(lm_baseline_trial2_group1and2)
```

```{r baseline trial regression results with (SI) Table. 11}
tab_model(lm_baseline_trial2_group1and2,
          title ="glm(which_intuition ~ object_cost, family=binomial(link='logit'))", 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "Z value", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Object cost"),
          dv.labels = c("the original owner has no intent to relinquish ownership"))
```

```{r main trials}
# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership, the second agent is ignorant and picked up the object
trial3_group2and4 <- data_voronoi%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==2 | which_Voronoi_group==4)%>%
  mutate(`Trial3 G2 & G4` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(2,4)))
lm_trial3_group2and4 <- glm(`Trial3 G2 & G4` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=trial3_group2and4)
summary(lm_trial3_group2and4)

# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership, the second agent is knowledgeable and picked up the object
trial1_group2and4 <- data_voronoi%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==2 | which_Voronoi_group==4)%>%
  mutate(`Trial1 G2 & G4` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(2,4)))
lm_trial1_group2and4 <- glm(`Trial1 G2 & G4` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=trial1_group2and4)
summary(lm_trial1_group2and4)

# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership, the second agent is ignorant and does not want the object
trial4_group1and2 <- data_voronoi%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==1 | which_Voronoi_group==2)%>%
  mutate(`Trial2 G1 & G2` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(1,2)))
lm_trial4_group1and2 <- glm(`Trial2 G1 & G2` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=trial4_group1and2)
summary(lm_trial4_group1and2)

# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership, the second agent is knowledgeable and does not want the object
trial2_group1and2 <- data_voronoi%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==1 | which_Voronoi_group==2)%>%
  mutate(`Trial4 G1 & G2` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(1,2)))
lm_trial2_group1and2 <- glm(`Trial4 G1 & G2` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=trial2_group1and2)
summary(lm_trial2_group1and2)
```

```{r main trial regression results with (SI) Table. 12}
tab_model(lm_trial3_group2and4, lm_trial1_group2and4, lm_trial4_group1and2, lm_trial2_group1and2,
```

# Analyses on predicted ownership agreement
```{r setup dataframe - join Voronoi data with predicted agreement}
actual_agreement <- Main_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
  rbind(Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs)%>%
  mutate(which_Voronoi_group=case_when(which_Voronoi_group_text=="G1\nneither A or B owns" ~ 1,
                                       which_Voronoi_group_text=="G2\nA owns, B doesn't" ~ 2,
                                       which_Voronoi_group_text=="G3\nunsure" ~ 3,
                                       which_Voronoi_group_text=="G4\nA doesn't, B owns" ~ 4,
                                       TRUE ~ 5))%>%
  select(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group,which_Voronoi_group_text,mean)

predicted_agreement <- data_voronoi%>%
  rbind(data_voronoi_baseline)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(agreement_rating=as.numeric(agreement_rating)*0.01,
         A_intentionality=factor(A_intentionality,levels=c("no drop-off","accidental drop","intentional drop")),
         B_intentionality=factor(B_intentionality, levels = c("Not Applicable", "no intent to own", "intend to own")),
         B_knowledge=factor(B_knowledge,levels = c("Not Applicable", "knowledgeable","ignorant")))%>%
  select(trial_condition, A_intentionality, B_intentionality, B_knowledge,which_Voronoi_group, A,B, unique_id, agreement_rating)

agreement_comparison <- predicted_agreement%>%
  left_join(actual_agreement)%>%
  mutate(diff_pred_actual = agreement_rating-mean)

agreement_comparison$trial_condition <- factor(agreement_comparison$trial_condition)
```

## Predicted agreement and one-intuition vs. two-intuitions trials
```{r set up dataframe}
agreement_comparison_num_intuitions <- agreement_comparison%>%
  mutate(num_intuitions = case_when(A_intentionality!="accidental drop" ~ "1 intuition",
                                    TRUE ~ "2 intuitions"),
         num_intuitions = factor(num_intuitions, levels=c("1 intuition", "2 intuitions")))%>%
  select(unique_id, num_intuitions, A_intentionality, B_intentionality, B_knowledge, agreement_rating, mean)%>%
  mutate(predicted_agreement = agreement_rating, true_agreement=mean)
```

```{r summary statistics based on numbers of intuitions}
# predicted agreement
agreement_comparison_num_intuitions%>%group_by(num_intuitions)%>%summarise(mean(predicted_agreement),sd(predicted_agreement))%>%as.data.frame()

# actual agreement
agreement_comparison_num_intuitions%>%group_by(num_intuitions)%>%summarise(mean(true_agreement),sd(true_agreement))%>%as.data.frame()
```

```{r lmer on predicted agreement}
q1_2 <- lmer(predicted_agreement ~ num_intuitions + (1 + num_intuitions|unique_id), data=agreement_comparison_num_intuitions)
summary(q1_2)
```

```{r predicted agreement regression results with (SI) Table. 13}
tab_model(q1_2,
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "t value", 
          dv.labels = c("Predicted agreement"))
```

## Predicted vs actual agreement
```{r set up data frame and run lmer on true agreement}
q1_agreement_comparison <- agreement_comparison%>%
  rename(predicted_agreement = agreement_rating, trial = trial_condition, true_agreement = mean)

q1 <- lmer(true_agreement ~ predicted_agreement + (1 + predicted_agreement|unique_id) 
                  + (1 + predicted_agreement|trial), data=q1_agreement_comparison)

summary(q1)
```


```{r summary statistics and paired t-test}
t.test(q1_agreement_comparison$predicted_agreement,q1_agreement_comparison$true_agreement, paired=TRUE)
```

## Difference in predicted and actual agreement & trial parameters
```{r}
# using buildmer() to find the maximally converging model
m3 <- buildmer(diff_pred_actual ~ A_intentionality + B_intentionality + B_knowledge + (1 + A_intentionality + B_intentionality + B_knowledge|unique_id)  + (1|trial_condition)
                 , data=agreement_comparison, direction="order", control=lmerControl(optimizer='bobyqa'))
formula(m3@model) # extract the converged model

# set up the dataframe and rename relevant parameters
q3_agreement_comparison <- agreement_comparison%>%rename(original_owner_intention=A_intentionality,
                              second_agent_intention=B_intentionality,
                              second_agent_knowledge=B_knowledge,
                              trial=trial_condition)

q3_2 <- lmer(diff_pred_actual ~ 1 + original_owner_intention + second_agent_intention + 
    second_agent_knowledge + (1 | unique_id) + (1 | trial), q3_agreement_comparison)
summary(q3_2)
```

```{r difference in predicted and actual agreement with (SI) Table. 15}
tab_model(q3_2,
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
```


## Exp. 1 & 2 – Mentalistic theory and physical possession theory scoring (SI)
```{r score for exp 1}
toCluster_data_prep1<- study1_voronoidata %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%
  select(unique_id, trial_condition, A_intentionality, B_intentionality, which_Voronoi_group)

# mentalistic
mentalistic_score <- toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise(score = sum(which_Voronoi_group==2))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(score_type = "mentalistic")

# non-mentalistic
B_intend_to_own_score <- toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  filter(B_intentionality=="intend to own")%>%
  mutate(B_intend_to_own_score = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==4 ~ 1,
                                           TRUE ~ 0))%>%
  select(unique_id,B_intend_to_own_score)%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise(B_intentional_score = sum(B_intend_to_own_score))%>%
  ungroup()

B_no_intent_to_own_score <- toCluster_data_prep1%>%
  filter(B_intentionality=="no intent to own" | B_intentionality=="Not Applicable")%>%
  mutate(B_no_intent_score = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==1 ~ 1,
                                           TRUE ~ 0))%>%
  select(unique_id,B_no_intent_score)%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise(B_unintentional_score = sum(B_no_intent_score))%>%
  ungroup()

non_mentalistic_score <- B_intend_to_own_score%>%
  left_join(B_no_intent_to_own_score)%>%
  mutate(score=B_intentional_score + B_unintentional_score)%>%
  select(unique_id,score)%>%
  mutate(score_type = "non-mentalistic")
  
subj_theory_score_long_study1 <- mentalistic_score%>%rbind(non_mentalistic_score)

subj_theory_score_wide_study1 <- subj_theory_score_long_study1%>%
```

## Assign intuitive theory group
```{r exp. 1 & 2 - decide which intuitive theory a participant have}
quantify_subj_theory2_studies_1and2 <- subj_theory_score_wide_studies1and2%>%
  mutate(which_theory = case_when(mentalistic>`non-mentalistic` ~ "mentalistic theory",
                                  mentalistic<`non-mentalistic` ~ "non-mentalistic theory",
                                  TRUE ~ "uncertain"),
         mentalistic_freq = mentalistic/5,
         nonmentalistic_freq = `non-mentalistic`/5)

quantify_subj_theory2_studies_1and2%>%
  group_by(which_theory)%>%
  summarise(n()/240)
```

```{r exp. 2 - join theory assignment with predicted agreement}
quantify_subj_theory2 <- subj_theory_score_wide%>%
  mutate(which_theory = case_when(mentalistic>`non-mentalistic` ~ "mentalistic theory",
                                  mentalistic<`non-mentalistic` ~ "non-mentalistic theory",
                                  TRUE ~ "uncertain"),
         mentalistic_freq = mentalistic/5,
         nonmentalistic_freq = `non-mentalistic`/5)

theory_agreement_comparison <- agreement_comparison%>%
  left_join(quantify_subj_theory2)
```

```{r lmer on true agreement based on predicted agreement and intuitive theory}
# set up dataframe
theory_agreement_comparison_1and3 <- theory_agreement_comparison%>%

                                                      predicted_agreement=agreement_rating,
                                                      trial=trial_condition)%>%
  mutate(which_theory=case_when(which_theory == "non-mentalistic theory" ~ "physical possession", 
                                TRUE ~ "mentalistic"),
         which_theory = factor(which_theory, levels = c("mentalistic", "physical possession")))

q4 <- lmer(true_agreement ~ predicted_agreement*which_theory + (1 + predicted_agreement | unique_id) + (1 + predicted_agreement*which_theory | trial),data=q4_data)
```

## Exp. 1 & 2 - Monte Carlo simulation of ownership judgments (SI)
see simulation code in Simulation of ownership judgment.rmd
### set up
```{r set up the diagonal score combination}
ls_strict_diagonal <- c("0 - 1", "0.2 - 0.8", "0.4 - 0.6", "0.6 - 0.4", "0.8 - 0.2", "1 - 0")
```

```{r read in simulation data}
df_all_sim1_scores <- read_csv("./data/simulation/01.ownership_simulated_score.csv")
```

```{r summarize for each simulation, how many agents fell in each of the score combinations}
df_all_sim1_score_summary <- df_all_sim1_scores%>%
  group_by(which_simulation,freq_combination)%>%
  summarise(count = n())
  
df_all_sim1_score_summary_wide <- df_all_sim1_score_summary%>%
  spread(freq_combination, count)

df_all_sim1_score_summary_wide[is.na(df_all_sim1_score_summary_wide)] <- 0
```

### evaluate simulated agent ratings on the diagonal pattern
```{r check if any rating falls only on the strict diagonal (SI)}
df_strict_count <- df_all_sim1_score_summary%>%
  filter(freq_combination %in% ls_strict_diagonal)%>%
  summarise(unique_count = n())

df_other_count <- df_all_sim1_score_summary%>%
  filter(!freq_combination %in% ls_strict_diagonal)%>%
  summarise(other_ct = n())

df_total_count <- df_all_sim1_score_summary%>%
  summarise(total_ct = n())

df_strict_diagonal_count <- df_total_count%>%
  left_join(df_other_count)%>%
  left_join(df_strict_count)

df_strict_diagonal_count[is.na(df_strict_diagonal_count)]<- 0

df_strict_diagonal_count <- df_strict_diagonal_count%>%
  mutate(only_diagonal = case_when(other_ct==0 ~ TRUE,
                                   TRUE ~ FALSE))

# how many simulations where only a strict diagonal pattern emerged?
df_strict_diagonal_count%>%
  summarise(prob = sum(only_diagonal==TRUE)/10000) # p < .0001
```

### compare empirical vs. simulated results
```{r}
sim1_mean_score <- df_all_sim1_scores%>%
  group_by(which_simulation, freq_combination)%>%
  summarise(count = n(),
            freq = count/240)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(freq_combination)%>%
  summarise(mean_count = sum(count)/10000,
            mean_sim_freq = sum(freq)/10000)%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  as.data.frame()%>%
  mutate(simulated_agent_num = round(mean_sim_freq,2) * 240)
  #mutate(simulated_agent_num =round(mean_count))
sum(sim1_mean_score$simulated_agent_num)
sum(sim1_mean_score$mean_count)

sim1_freq_combination_score <- df_all_sim1_scores%>%
  group_by(freq_combination)%>%
  summarise(count=n(),
            mean_count = sum(count)/10000,
            mean_freq = mean_count/240)
```

```{r}
empirical_score <- quantify_subj_theory2_studies_1and2%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(freq_combination = paste(mentalistic_freq,"-",nonmentalistic_freq))%>%
  group_by(freq_combination)%>%
  summarise(empirical_count = n())%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  rbind(c("0 - 0", 0), # manually add in for score combinations that didn't appear in empirical data
        c("0 - 0.2", 0),
        c("0 - 0.4", 0),
        c("0.2 - 0", 0),
        c("0.2 - 0.2", 0),
        c("0.4 - 0", 0))%>%
  mutate(empirical_count=as.numeric(empirical_count))
```

```{r}
compare_sim_empirical <- empirical_score%>%
  left_join(sim1_mean_score)%>%
  select(-freq_combination,-mean_sim_freq)%>%
  mutate(mean_count = as.numeric(mean_count),simulated_agent_num=as.numeric(simulated_agent_num))
```

### Are people evenly spread out on a mentalistic-physical spectrum, or are they concentrated toward the two ends?
#### empirical vs. analytical
```{r compare empirical result vs. analytical solution}
empirical_diagonal_total <- empirical_score%>%
  filter(freq_combination %in% ls_strict_diagonal)%>%
  summarise(count = sum(empirical_count))

empirical_diagnal_distribution <- empirical_score%>%
  filter(freq_combination %in% ls_strict_diagonal)%>%
  mutate(empirical_freq = empirical_count/empirical_diagonal_total$count)

empirical_diagnal_count_distribution <- empirical_score%>%
  filter(freq_combination %in% ls_strict_diagonal)

random_diagnal_distribution <- data.frame(freq_combination = ls_strict_diagonal,
                                          analytical_count = c(1,5,10,10,5,1),
                                          analytical_freq = c(1/32, 5/32,10/32,10/32,5/32,1/32))

compare_random_empirical_diagonal <- empirical_diagnal_distribution%>%
  left_join(random_diagnal_distribution)

long_random_empirical_diagonal <- compare_random_empirical_diagonal%>%
  select(freq_combination, empirical_freq, analytical_freq)%>%
  gather(data_type, freq, empirical_freq,analytical_freq)
```

#### empirical vs. expected by chance
```{r calculate percentages of participants for each score combination on the diagonal}
empirical_strict_diagnal <- empirical_score%>%
  filter(freq_combination %in% ls_strict_diagonal)%>%
  mutate(freq_combination = factor(freq_combination,levels = ls_strict_diagonal))

sum_on_diagonal <- sum(empirical_strict_diagnal$empirical_count)
sum_on_diagonal/240 # % of participants on the diagonal

empirical_strict_diagnal%>%
  mutate(percent = empirical_count/sum_on_diagonal)

28.2 + 28.8 # % of participants on the extremes
```

```{r calculate simulation diagonal conditional prob}
sim1_diagonal_distribution <- df_all_sim1_scores%>%
  filter(freq_combination %in% ls_strict_diagonal)%>%
  group_by(which_simulation, freq_combination)%>%
  summarise(sim_count = n())%>%
  ungroup()

sim1_diagonal_distribution$freq_combination <- factor(sim1_diagonal_distribution$freq_combination,levels = ls_strict_diagonal)

sim1_diagonal_distribution$sim_count <- as.numeric(sim1_diagonal_distribution$sim_count)

sim1_diagonal_total <- sim1_diagonal_distribution%>%group_by(which_simulation)%>%summarise(count = sum(sim_count))

total_no_of_sim1<- nrow(sim1_diagonal_total)

sim1_diagonal_distribution <- sim1_diagonal_distribution%>%
  left_join(sim1_diagonal_total)%>%
  mutate(single_sim_freq = sim_count/count)

sim1_aggregate_diagonal_distribution <- sim1_diagonal_distribution%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(freq_combination)%>%
  summarise(sim_freq = sum(single_sim_freq)/total_no_of_sim1,
            sim_ct = sim_freq*sum(empirical_diagnal_count_distribution$empirical_count)
            )%>%
  ungroup()

sim1_aggregate_diagonal_distribution$freq_combination <- factor(sim1_aggregate_diagonal_distribution$freq_combination,levels = ls_strict_diagonal)

sim1_aggregate_diagonal_distribution$sim_freq <- as.numeric(sim1_aggregate_diagonal_distribution$sim_freq)

# alternative way to calculate to validate the freq above
total_diagonal_sim1 <- sum(sim1_diagonal_distribution$sim_count)
sim1_freq_temp <- sim1_diagonal_distribution%>%
  group_by(freq_combination)%>%
  summarise(cell_count = sum(sim_count),
            cell_freq = cell_count/total_diagonal_sim1)
```

```{r compare empirical and simulated results with chi-square}
compare_sim_empirical_withChiSquare <- empirical_diagnal_count_distribution%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  left_join(sim1_aggregate_diagonal_distribution)%>%
  ungroup()%>%select(-freq_combination,-sim_freq)

chisq.test(compare_sim_empirical_withChiSquare)
cramers_v(compare_sim_empirical_withChiSquare, alternative = "two.sided")
```

# (Re-visit the correlation matrix) Ordering the correlation matrix using intuitive theory scores
```{r set the participant order for correlation matrix}
# the mentalistic extreme
cluster_mentalistic_IDs <- quantify_subj_theory2_studies_1and2%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(freq_combination = paste(mentalistic_freq,"-",nonmentalistic_freq))%>%
  filter(freq_combination=="1 - 0")%>%
  select(unique_id)%>%
  left_join(df_match_unique_simple_IDs_studies1and2)

# the physical possession extreme
cluster_physical_IDs <- quantify_subj_theory2_studies_1and2%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(freq_combination = paste(mentalistic_freq,"-",nonmentalistic_freq))%>%
  filter(freq_combination=="0 - 1")%>%
  select(unique_id)%>%
  left_join(df_match_unique_simple_IDs_studies1and2)

# the ones in between
order_ownership_score <- c("0.8 - 0", "0.8 - 0.2", "0.6 - 0", "0.6 - 0.2", "0.6 - 0.4", 
                           "0.4 - 0.2", "0.4 - 0.4", "0.4 - 0.6", 
                           "0.2 - 0.4", "0.2 - 0.6", "0.2 - 0.8",
                           "0 - 0.6", "0 - 0.8")

cluster_uncertain_IDs <- quantify_subj_theory2_studies_1and2%>%
  filter(!unique_id %in% cluster_mentalistic_IDs$unique_id)%>%
  filter(!unique_id %in% cluster_physical_IDs$unique_id)%>%
  left_join(df_match_unique_simple_IDs_studies1and2)%>%
  mutate(freq_combination = paste(mentalistic_freq,"-",nonmentalistic_freq),
         freq_combination = factor(freq_combination, levels=order_ownership_score))%>%
  arrange(freq_combination)%>% 
  mutate(simple_id = fct_inorder(factor(simple_id)))%>%
  select(unique_id, simple_id)

# combine all IDs in set order
cluster_IDs_order_v1 <- rbind(cluster_mentalistic_IDs,cluster_uncertain_IDs,cluster_physical_IDs)%>%
  select(simple_id)

# sort correlation matrix based on this new order
cor_prep_scores_v1 <- cor_prep_2_studies1and2[,cluster_IDs_order_v1$simple_id]

# calculate correlation
res.cor_scores_v1 <- cor(cor_prep_scores_v1)
```

```{r prepare to export data for (SI) voronoi figure by cluster}
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group)%>%
  summarise(perc = n()/95)%>%
  spread(which_Voronoi_group,perc)%>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0)

#write_csv(cluster_mentalistic_groups,"./data/exp-1and2/00.exp1and2-mentalistic-group-voronoi.csv")
#write_csv(cluster_physical_groups, "./data/exp-1and2/01.exp1and2-physical-group-voronoi.csv")
```

# Explore demographic information and intuitive ownership theories
```{r include zipcode data}
data(zipcode)
filtered_attn_checks <- attn_checks%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)%>%
  rename(zip=zipcpde_response)%>%
  select(unique_id, IP_info:city_fromIP, object_cost_response:batch)%>%
  left_join(zipcode)
```

```{r create dataframe for looking at political ideology and ownership group}
subj_demographics <-  quantify_subj_theory2%>%
  left_join(filtered_attn_checks)%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)%>%
  select(unique_id, which_theory, state,country_response,age_response, 
         race_response, gender_response,education_response, income_response,politics_response)%>%
  mutate(age_response = as.numeric(age_response),politics_response_numerical = politics_response,
         politics_response = case_when(politics_response_numerical==1 ~ "Very \nliberal",
                                       politics_response_numerical==2 ~ "Somewhat \nliberal",
                                       politics_response_numerical==3 ~ "Moderate",
                                       politics_response_numerical==4 ~ "Somewhat \nconservative",
                                       politics_response_numerical==5 ~ "Very \nconservative"),
         politics_response = factor(politics_response, levels=c("Very \nliberal","Somewhat \nliberal","Moderate",
                                                                "Somewhat \nconservative","Very \nconservative")),
         gender_response = factor(gender_response, levels=c("Female","Male","Non-binary",
                                                                "Prefer not to answer")),
         which_theory=factor(which_theory,levels=c("mentalistic theory", "non-mentalistic theory","uncertain")))

subj_demographics_2theories <- subj_demographics%>%
  filter(which_theory!="uncertain")%>%
  rename(which_theory_initial = which_theory,
         political_ideology_score = politics_response)%>%
  mutate(which_theory = case_when(which_theory_initial=="mentalistic theory" ~ "mentalistic",
                                      which_theory_initial=="non-mentalistic theory" ~ "physical possession"),
         which_theory=factor(which_theory, levels = c("mentalistic", "physical possession")))
```

## Political orientation
```{r logistic regression on political orientation}
lm_political_orientation <- glm(which_theory ~political_ideology_score,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=subj_demographics_2theories)

summary(lm_political_orientation)
```

```{r political orientation regression with (SI) Table. 17}
tab_model(lm_political_orientation,
          title ="glm(which_theory ~ political_ideology_score, family=binomial(link='logit'))", 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "Z value")
```

## Income and ADI ranking
```{r set up dataframe}
ADI_income <- read_csv("./data/geographical-info/00.exp2_ADI_income_info.csv")

ADI_income_which_theory <- quantify_subj_theory2%>%left_join(ADI_income)%>%filter(which_theory!="uncertain")%>%mutate(num_which_theory= case_when(which_theory=="mentalistic theory" ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0))%>%
  rename(which_theory_initial = which_theory)%>%
  mutate(which_theory = case_when(which_theory_initial=="mentalistic theory" ~ "mentalistic",
                                      which_theory_initial=="non-mentalistic theory" ~ "physical possession"),
         which_theory=factor(which_theory, levels = c("mentalistic", "physical possession")))

ADI_which_theory <- ADI_income_which_theory%>%filter(ADI_NATRANK!="GQ" & ADI_NATRANK!="PH" & ADI_NATRANK!="GQ-PH")%>%mutate(ADI_NATRANK=as.numeric(ADI_NATRANK))

income_which_theory <- ADI_income_which_theory%>%mutate(income_10000to1 = zipcodeR_median_household_income/10000,
                                                        income_Zscored = (zipcodeR_median_household_income - mean(zipcodeR_median_household_income))/sd(zipcodeR_median_household_income))
```

### scaled median income
```{r logistic regression on theory and scaled median income}
# raw dollars
summary(glm(num_which_theory~zipcodeR_median_household_income, data=income_which_theory, family=binomial(link='logit')))

# changing units: 10,000 to 1 
lm_income <- glm(which_theory ~ income_10000to1, data=income_which_theory, family=binomial(link='logit'))
summary(glm(which_theory ~ income_10000to1, data=income_which_theory, family=binomial(link='logit')))
```

```{r scaled median area income with (SI) Table. 18}
tab_model(lm_income,
          title ="glm(which_theory ~ income_10000to1, family=binomial(link='logit'))", 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "Z value", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "scaled median income"))
```

### Neighborhood atlas - ADI national rank
```{r logistic regression on theory and ADI ranking}
lm_adi <- glm(which_theory ~ ADI_NATRANK, data=ADI_which_theory, family=binomial(link='logit'))
summary(lm_adi)
```

```{r ADI national ranking regression with (SI) Table. 19}
tab_model(lm_adi,
          title ="glm(which_theory ~ ADI_NATRANK, family=binomial(link='logit'))", 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "Z value", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "ADI NATRANK"))
```

## Compare empirical results with chance
```{r}
compare_sim_random_empirical_diagonal <- compare_random_empirical_diagonal%>%
  left_join(sim1_aggregate_diagonal_distribution)

long_sim_random_empirical_diagonal <- compare_sim_random_empirical_diagonal%>%
  gather(data_type, freq, analytical_freq, empirical_freq, sim_freq)%>%
  mutate(data_type = factor(data_type,levels=c("empirical_freq","analytical_freq", "sim_freq")))
```

```{r prep for scatter plot}
combination_freq_score<- df_all_sim1_scores%>%
  select(freq_combination,mentalistic_freq,nonmentalistic_freq)%>%
  distinct()

sim1_temp1 <- sim1_mean_score%>%
  select(freq_combination,simulated_agent_num)%>%
  rename(count = simulated_agent_num)%>% # note that this total is 241 rather than 240
  left_join(combination_freq_score)

sim1_forScatterPlot <- cbind(rep(sim1_temp1$freq_combination,times=sim1_temp1$count),rep(sim1_temp1$count,times=sim1_temp1$count),rep(sim1_temp1$mentalistic_freq,times=sim1_temp1$count),rep(sim1_temp1$nonmentalistic_freq,times=sim1_temp1$count))%>%as.data.frame()

colnames(sim1_forScatterPlot) <- c('freq_combination','count','mentalistic_freq','nonmentalistic_freq')

sim1_forScatterPlot <- sim1_forScatterPlot%>%
  mutate(count=as.numeric(count),
         mentalistic_freq = as.numeric(mentalistic_freq),
         nonmentalistic_freq = as.numeric(nonmentalistic_freq),
         data_type="simulated")%>%
  select(-count,-freq_combination)

```

```{r Figure. 6 - empirical vs. expected by chance}
#pdf(file = "./empirical vs. simulation - v0.pdf", width = 13, height = 13) # uncomment for save pdf file
# Figure. 6(a) and (b)
plot_scatter <- quantify_subj_theory2_studies_1and2%>%
  mutate(data_type="empirical")%>%
  select(colnames(sim1_forScatterPlot))%>%
  rbind(sim1_forScatterPlot)%>%
  ggplot(aes(mentalistic_freq,nonmentalistic_freq,color=data_type))+
  geom_jitter(alpha=.7,size=3, width = .04,height = .04)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#4B77BE","#6C7A89"))+
  facet_wrap(~data_type)+
  xlim(-.05,1.05)+
  ylim(-.05,1.05)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8,1))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8,1))+
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.line.x.bottom=element_line(size=.8),
        axis.line.y.left =element_line(size=.8),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(size=.8),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(size=.8),
        axis.text = element_text(size=14,color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=16,color="black"))

# Figure. 6(c) and (d)
plot_freq <- long_sim_random_empirical_diagonal%>%
  filter(data_type != "analytical_freq")%>%
  ggplot(aes(freq_combination, freq, fill=data_type))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",position=position_dodge(width=1),color="black",linewidth=1)+
  facet_wrap(~data_type,ncol=2)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("#4B77BE","#6C7A89"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 340,size=15,color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=15,color="black"),
        axis.line.x.bottom=element_line(size=.8),
        axis.line.y.left =element_line(size=.8),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(size=.8),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(size=.8),
        axis.title = element_text(size=16,color="black"))+
  xlab("mentalistic - physical continuum")+
  ylab("frequency distribution")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(plot_scatter,plot_freq)

#dev.off() # uncomment for save pdf file
```

## US map and intuitive theories
```{r set up IP address dataframe}
ip_theory <- quantify_subj_theory2%>%
  left_join(filtered_attn_checks)%>%
  select(unique_id,latitude,longitude,which_theory)%>%
  rename(lat=latitude,lon=longitude)%>%
  mutate(which_theory_map = case_when(which_theory=="mentalistic theory" ~ "mentalistic",
                                      which_theory=="non-mentalistic theory" ~ "physical possession",
                                      TRUE ~ "uncertain"))
```

```{r (SI) Figure. 4 - intuitive theory on U.S. map}
ip_theory_transformed <- usmap_transform(ip_theory)

plot_usmap() +
  geom_jitter(data = ip_theory_transformed, aes(x = x, y = y, color = which_theory_map),
             alpha = .7,size=2) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#D55E00", "#0072B2","#E4DFDA"),name="ownership theory")+
  labs(title = "Ownership theories by geographical location",
       subtitle = "n=120 (exp. 2)") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
